title: Shell automatically resumes interrupted agent turns after connectivity or provider recovery

AC1.note: Real readline REPL emits one turn_start and no early turn_end while waiting; completes without another prompt; verified by test in PR 926

AC2.note: Scripted 18-failure outage succeeds on attempt 19 with maxRounds=1; verified by test in PR 926

AC3.note: Provisional text/reasoning/replay absent from checkpoint snapshots and retried messages; verified by test in PR 926

AC4.note: Complete arguments followed by error invoke no tool; prior successful write invokes/approves exactly once; verified by test in PR 926

AC5.note: Production abortable wait, cancellation before retry and mid-output pass; verified by test in PR 926

AC6.note: maxRounds=1 survives long outage; prior tools/approval preserved; usage forwarded; verified by test in PR 926

AC7.note: Generic 403 authentication/invalid_request fixtures do not retry; access guidance asserted; verified by test in PR 926

AC8.note: Readline events prove no success-looking end during recovery; headless OpenTUI frame shows recovering/interrupted; verified by test in PR 926

AC9.note: 26 deterministic recovery tests plus real readline and headless renderer tests; verified by test in PR 926

AC10.note: README and docs/docs/shell-recovery.md explain policy, defaults and boundaries; verified in PR 926
